profile_text.body:
OctoAI is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, USA. Its website is octo.ai. That is the whole of the company profile information available.

The text gathered from the site does not describe OctoAI's own business. It reads as NVIDIA material, in which NVIDIA describes itself as the inventor of the GPU and covers NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, NeMo Switchyard, RTX, DLSS 4, GeForce RTX 50 Series GPUs, Jetson, Isaac, and DGX Spark, along with events on October 20-22 and October 21-22. The same text states that Deci was acquired by NVIDIA Corporation of Santa Clara, CA in May 2024 and dissolved as a separate corporate entity. No OctoAI products are listed.

No lawsuits are listed for the company, and no MCP servers are listed. The legal exposure entry is Washington, with a count of 102.
